description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with Effect from 16.01.2023 to 22.01.2023
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the determination of exchange rates for customs duties and charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory matter issued by the Director General of Customs, exercising powers vested by law. The content focuses on legal compliance and financial regulations, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) which include "regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "statutory instruments."
